title: Sponsors
description: We would like to thank our sponsors for their generous support. Find out more about our sponsors below.

descriptions.cgi: CGI is one of the world's largest independent IT and business consulting services firms, helping organizations accelerate digital transformation and achieve measurable results.
descriptions.ciena: Ciena is a global networking systems, services, and software company whose technology enables fast, reliable, and scalable connectivity.
descriptions.elevenlabs: ElevenLabs is an AI audio research and deployment company that develops tools for generating and transforming speech, voices, and sound.
descriptions.backboard: Backboard develops AI infrastructure and tools that help teams build and operate AI-powered software.
descriptions.uosu: The University of Ottawa Students' Union represents undergraduate students at uOttawa and provides services and events for its members.
descriptions.eef: The Engineering Endowment Fund supports projects and initiatives that benefit undergraduate engineering students at the University of Ottawa.
descriptions.mathematech: MathemaTech offers one-on-one tutoring in math, science and coding and develops Fermat, an AI tutor.
